It is a fixture for docs/SWIPL_MEASUREMENT.md, not authoring content.

Six clauses of throwaway fixture data (parent/2, likes/2) chosen to exercise quoting and variable rendering. Contract-level by construction: the file exists to pin the snapshot FORMAT, which is part of the published ABI.

findings.reason: The ABI bootstrap — the Prolog that IS libinsimul's C layer (running goals, serialising the binding-set JSON, classifying ISO errors, snapshotting). Every promise include/insimul.h makes is implemented here. It is engine plumbing, the open half of the content boundary by definition: a runtime cannot be shown conformant against an ABI whose implementation it cannot read. No genre bundle, no language corpus, no generation heuristic. Five blobs = five revisions of the same file.

findings.reason: The vendored Prolog ENGINE's own standard library (39 files: lists, assoc, dcgs, clpz, format, …), not authoring content. It is upstream Trealla's `library/` directory at the pinned commit 07de013677af760a8bca0594ae4b2bef158a3cde, licensed BSD-2-Clause (docs/TREALLA_LICENSE_FINDING.md §4), and the bytes on disk are PROVEN to be upstream's by tests/run_trealla_vendor.sh, which recomputes git's own tree/blob ids for every vendored path offline. So this is not a judgement about 39 files nobody read: it is a judgement about one pinned upstream directory whose identity is already a ctest. A prefix allowance rather than 39 entries — see allowanceFor() in history-scan.mjs for why that is the safer of the two.
